d: Professional building inspections across Victoria, including construction-stage inspections and practical completion inspections.
b: Building inspections Know what's happening behind the walls. Book Your Building Inspection Online Building inspections can now be conveniently booked online. Please review the available inspection times and booking requirements before submitting your request. Please select your preferred inspection date and time when making your online booking. The inspection report will be released upon receipt of full payment. Inspection Days Monday to Friday, excluding weekends. Available Inspection Time Slots Morning: 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM Afternoon: 2:00 PM – 5:00 PM Booking Requirements Bookings must be made at least 3 business days in advance (weekends don't count). You can book an inspection up to one month ahead. All bookings are subject to availability. Inspection Fees Choose your property type, bedrooms and bathrooms to see the fee. All prices are subject to 10% GST. No additional charge for an additional WC, study room or office room. Building inspections A new home is made up of thousands of components. An inspection at the right stage can help identify construction issues before they become difficult or expensive to address. Nexcon provides building inspection services across Victoria. Inspection services Pre-purchase inspections Understand the condition of an existing property before making a purchase decision. Construction-stage inspections Inspect important stages of a new build as construction progresses. Frame inspection Review framing before subsequent construction stages cover the structure. Lock-up inspection Assess the property when the building envelope is substantially enclosed. Practical completion inspection Identify outstanding works and defects before final completion. Defect inspections Document defects and items requiring rectification. How it works 1 Choose your inspection An existing Building Inspection, or a Practical Completion (PCI) Inspection for a newly built home. 2 We walk the site An inspector checks structure, compliance, and finish against the approved plans and Australian Standards. 3 You get a report Issues are documented with photos, so you know exactly what to raise before you sign off. Inspection reports Our reports can include: Photographs Observations Identified defects Areas requiring attention Recommendations Construction-stage information What's included Every part of the home, photographed and documented Areas we check Every habitable room and service area of the home: entry, hallways, living and dining areas, kitchen, bedrooms, bathrooms, ensuite, walk-in robe, laundry, WC, roof space, subfloor, garage or carport, verandah, and outdoor areas. What we look for General wear and cracking, rust on structural steel, timber rot, loose or unstable brickwork, doors and windows that don't open or close properly, and blocked subfloor ventilation, documented with photos as we go.
